name: Earthy theme and mobile base
purpose: Site v0 has no palette, viewport tag or overflow protection.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if the single call does not produce the viewport tag and CSS variables; no retry money is available.

completion_check: Viewport meta tag present, palette defined as CSS variables, and scrollWidth equals clientWidth at 360px and 1280px.
last_check: style guide, usable section and head tags

name: Header, products and filters
purpose: No header, navigation or product listing exists, and visitors cannot narrow products by size or price.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if the run has used all 3 calls and the 10 products or a working filter are still missing.

completion_check: Title and header contain Thread & Loom and Pune. Exactly 10 products at the exact prices. Choosing a size or price range changes the visible cards, and Free size shows the 3 sarees and 2 dupattas. No console errors.

name: Visit block
purpose: Visitors cannot find the shop address, timings or phone.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if the address, timings or tel: link are missing after the single call.

completion_check: Section shows the exact address and timings, and the phone is an anchor with a tel: href for +91 00000 22222.

name: WhatsApp order links
purpose: Product cards have no order link; F-7 finds no wa.me link anywhere in the file.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if 2 calls are used and any of the 10 cards lacks a wa.me/910000011111 link containing its product name, or if the run would exceed 23 money.

outputs: Order on WhatsApp link on each of the 10 product cards
completion_check: 10 product cards each contain an a[href^='https://wa.me/910000011111'] whose text param contains that card's exact product name; no JS errors; no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px.

name: Size guide
purpose: No #size-guide section exists, so the size-guide nav link is broken and visitors cannot see chest measurements.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if 2 calls are used and #size-guide with all six chest values is still missing, or if spend would exceed 17.

completion_check: An element with id size-guide contains a table listing XS 32, S 34, M 36, L 38, XL 40, XXL 42; no JS errors; no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px.
